dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's someone who looks just like you...

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: You've met Galvaryet? She's my younger sister. We're twins. *ahem* She's too old to keep calling me Sis all the time...

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: Oh, please don't take it the wrong way. I don't dislike her at all, it's just... This is our workplace, and we should be more serious when it's work hours!
